# sketchywolf

> > A fountain pen review blog dedicated to exploring budget-friendly and mid-range pens from Chinese and international brands, with detailed comparisons and writing instrument recommendations.

sketchywolf is a passionate fountain pen enthusiast blog focusing on reviews of affordable pens from brands like Majohn, Wing Sung, Hero, Jinhao, and Moonman, often comparing them to premium alternatives. The site combines detailed pen reviews with pen design analysis and budget pen recommendations for collectors and everyday writers.

## Key Topics

- Majohn
- Wing Sung
- Jinhao
- Moonman
- Hero 565
- Fountain pen reviews
- Budget pens
- Eyedropper pens
- Piston filler
- Pen comparisons
- Affordable pens
- Writing instruments
- Pen design
- Montblanc alternatives
- Chinese pen brands

## Core Pages

- [sketchywolf – where a badlydrawn wolf continues the journey](https://sketchywolf.wordpress.com): Homepage featuring fountain pen reviews and comparisons of brands like Majohn, Moonman, Kaweco
- [About – sketchywolf](https://sketchywolf.wordpress.com/about): About page introducing sketchywolf's pen reviews, art, and inks with social media links

## Fountain Pen Reviews

- [Majohn A2, fountainpen review](https://sketchywolf.wordpress.com/2023/06/17/majohn-a2-fountainpen-review): Review of Majohn A2 fountain pen as Pilot Capless alternative
- [Majohn C4, fountain pen review](https://sketchywolf.wordpress.com/2023/04/06/majohn-c4-fountain-pen-review): Review of Majohn C4 eyedropper fountain pen and budget pen comparison
- [Hero 565, fine fountain pen review](https://sketchywolf.wordpress.com/2023/03/18/hero-565-fine-fountain-pen-review): Review of Hero 565 budget fountain pen with fine nib and vintage style
- [Majohn S7, eyedropper fountain pen review](https://sketchywolf.wordpress.com/2022/12/14/majohn-s7-eyedropper-fountain-pen-review): Review of Majohn S7 eyedropper piston filler demonstrator pen
- [Wing Sung 629 fountain pen review](https://sketchywolf.wordpress.com/2022/12/13/wing-sung-629-fountain-pen-review): Review of Wing Sung 629 piston filler pen inspired by Montblanc 146
